svg.title: llm-release-gate: baseline vs candidate on a golden replay (animated)
svg.desc: Animated loop of the README red demo: the candidate swaps demo-pro-1 for demo-mini-1 and cuts cost by 96 percent. Both configurations replay the golden dataset offline, the scorers compare quality, abstention, citations, schema, latency and cost, three threshold rules fail, and the pull request check fails with exit 1.
